title: Universal scalar and section comparison diagram predicates
statement: Let $c:R\to S$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with coefficient changes $c_X:R_X\to S_X$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change], with their pulled-back coefficients [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], exact inverse image $b^*$ and unbounded derived direct image $Rb_*$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let $r_X$ be exact scalar restriction [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] on ordinary derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $E_{R,W}$ for underlying section evaluation at a site object $W$, $Q$ for localization, $\alpha_{R,W,P}:Q E_{R,W}P\to RE_{R,W}(QP)$ for the universal computation unit [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], and $\theta_b:r_{X'}b_S^*\cong b_R^*r_X$ for the canonical coefficient/pullback comparison, with the coefficient comparisons $r_Yb_{*,S}=b_{*,R}r_X$ and $\theta_b$ of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-comparisons]. Use the recorded evaluation and direct-image section identity [lem-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-models]. Define $\gamma_W:RE_{S,W}\to RE_{R,W}r_X$ by deriving the identity $E_{S,W}=E_{R,W}r_X$ through this universal unit. For a scheme map $b:X'\to X$, site objects $W,W'$ and site arrow $t:W'\to X'\times_X W$, define $u_{b,t}:E_{R,W}\to E_{R,W'}b_R^*$ to be the actual ordinary adjunction unit followed by the direct-image section identity and restriction along $t$ [def-sfb-proetale-inverse-image-unit-section]; define $Ru_{b,t}$ by its universal derived comparison. Define $p_{b,W}:RE_{R,W}Rb_*\cong RE_{R,X'\times_X W}$ as derived composition normalized by that ordinary section identity. Write $\delta_b:r_X Rb_{*,S}\to Rb_{*,R}r_{X'}$ for the existing forward comparison induced by $r_Xb_{*,S}=b_{*,R}r_{X'}$, $\eta,\varepsilon$ for the specified derived adjunction, $\kappa$ for exact pullback composition, and $\mathrm{Ex}$ for its unit--square--counit mate [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps]. Define UniversalCoherence$(c)$ to mean the following five families of equations: $r\alpha^S_P;\delta_{QP}=Q(b_*r\cong rb_*);\alpha^R_{rP}$, with the canonical exact-$Q$ comparison factors; $r\eta^S;\delta_{b,b_S^*M};Rb_{*,R}\theta_b=\eta^R_{rM}$; $r\varepsilon^S=\theta_{b,Rb_{*,S}N};b_R^*\delta_{b,N};\varepsilon^R_{rN}$; $\theta_b;b_R^*\theta_g=r\kappa_S^{-1};\theta_{g\circ b};\kappa_R$; and for every commuting square $(h,f_Z,f,s)$, $\theta_s^{-1};r\mathrm{Ex}_S;\delta_{f_Z};Rf_{Z*,R}\theta_h=s_R^*\delta_f;\mathrm{Ex}_R$. Define SectionCoherence$(c)$ to mean: $\alpha^S_{W,P};\gamma_{W,QP};RE_{R,W}(Q rP\cong rQP)=\alpha^R_{W,rP}$ for every complex $P$; $u^S_{b,t};E_{R,W'}\theta_b=u^R_{b,t}r$; $Ru^S_{b,t};\gamma_{W'};RE_{R,W'}\theta_b=\gamma_W;Ru^R_{b,t}$; and $p^S_{b,W};\gamma_{X'\times_XW}=\gamma_W;RE_{R,W}\delta_b;p^R_{b,W}$. All equations include the canonical exact-localization factors, are in the full unbounded derived categories, and do not assert invertibility of $\delta$ or $\gamma$, or preservation of K-injectives by $r$. These are definitions of predicates, not assertions that the equations hold.
